scientific_role.frozen_primary_analysis: The completed three-seed RTX analysis remains the prespecified primary analysis and is never overwritten.
scientific_role.held_out_replication: Seeds 3404 and 3405 are reported separately as a two-seed directional replication with descriptive estimates only.
scientific_role.pooled_analysis: The five-seed analysis is a post-hoc completion of the seed set specified in the original pre-outcome mechanisms lock; it is not relabeled as prespecified or confirmatory.
scientific_role.permutation_replicas: The four target permutations remain nested Monte Carlo draws within each run seed and are never counted as independent replicates.

operational_correction.trigger: The zero-outcome v1 attempt showed that a fresh pinned Mammoth checkout already owns NOTICE.md, while the uncorrected overlay installer attempted to include the source provenance notice at the same path.
operational_correction.parent_identity_match: Exact overlay identity used by all authenticated completed parent mechanism units.

mammoth_cli_identity_correction.trigger: The v2 attempt exposed pinned Mammoth's deterministic underscore-to-hyphen parser normalization when the first pairing model was constructed; four reference-only units had completed and no pairing-model outcome had been produced.
mammoth_cli_identity_correction.accepted_cli_spellings: Each adapter accepts only its exact canonical underscore name or the exact hyphenated spelling produced by pinned Mammoth.
mammoth_cli_identity_correction.construction_scope: The model identifier is canonicalized only while the authenticated overlay class is constructed, then the original parser value is restored.
mammoth_cli_identity_correction.argument_scope: All locked scientific Mammoth arguments are otherwise preserved byte-for-byte; explicit replay minibatch values are retained across Mammoth dataset extension.
mammoth_cli_identity_correction.reexecution_policy: A fresh v3 namespace reruns all 108 image units so every new outcome shares one source identity; the four valid v2 reference outcomes remain preserved but are not mixed into v3.
